'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Seth Acree LS You Can Either Profit By This Or Be Destroyed''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Seth Acree]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Light'''. Handwritten. Line 6 '''Han''' → Han Solo; line 22 '''Obi-Wan's Saber''' → Obi-Wan's Lightsaber; line 35 Lando with Vibro Axe → Lando With Vibro-Ax. Shield 12 '''Weapon's Display''' → Weapons Display (V).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Can Either Profit By This Or Be Destroyed]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
